fixes.old: Why? Because you're a special crew, set apart for God, your God. He literally chose you out of everyone on Earth to be His personal treasure. That's some HONORED treatment right there.
fixes.new: Why? Because you're a special crew, set apart for God, your God. He literally chose you out of everyone on Earth to be His personal treasure. That's some HOLY treatment right there.
fixes.message_ref: MSG Deut 7:6: 'Do this because you are a people set apart as holy to God, your God. God, your God, chose you out of all the people on Earth for himself as a cherished, personal treasure.'
fixes.reason: The Message says 'holy', not honored. EN's caps-lock 'HONORED treatment' is exactly the holy→honored mistranslation. Restored 'HOLY' in the same teen-voice sentence.

fixes.message_ref: MSG 1 Kgs 8:29: 'May you watch over this Temple night and day, this place where you have said, \'My name will be there.\''
fixes.reason: The Message says God's name will be THERE (dwelling presence), not 'honored'. 'Honored' misstates Solomon's request. Restored MSG wording.
